purpose: ask, before interpreting any classifier score, whether the three phases are separable in INSTANTANEOUS shared10 pose space

pca_visualisation.note: PCA is fitted on ALL interior frames for VISUALISATION ONLY.  It is never a model input and no classifier in this branch uses it

nearest_neighbour_phase_mixing.method: for each interior frame of a held-out subject, the nearest neighbour among ALL interior frames of the OTHER subjects; repeated per subject; deterministic subsampling

variance_decomposition.interpretation: the phase signal is the WITHIN-subject part.  A large between/within ratio means subject identity is an easier axis than phase, which is exactly why the protocol is subject-grouped and why subject id is never a feature

reaching_vs_releasing.verdict: REACHING and RELEASING centroids are within ~1 pooled SD: instantaneous pose alone is expected to be weak on this pair
